content.value_statement: Medical device teams need controlled QMS processes that match ISO 13485 expectations. This skill helps plan documentation, audits, reviews, CAPA work, and certification readiness.
actual_capabilities: Maps ISO 13485 QMS implementation work into gap analysis, documentation, training, metrics, and feedback steps.
Designs document control workflows for creation, approval, distribution, change control, retention, and disposal.
Structures management review inputs, meeting cadence, decisions, action tracking, and effectiveness follow-up.
Plans internal audit programs with risk-based schedules, audit scopes, checklists, and CAPA follow-up.
Connects design controls, ISO 14971 risk management, supplier quality, and regulatory inspection readiness.
limitations: It provides guidance and templates, not formal certification, legal advice, or regulatory approval.
Company-specific procedures, records, product risks, and regulatory markets must be supplied by the user.
Referenced scripts and assets are placeholders in this package, so automation is not implemented.
Outputs need review by qualified quality, regulatory, and leadership stakeholders before use.

use_cases.title: QMS Implementation Planning
use_cases.description: Build a phased ISO 13485 implementation roadmap with gap priorities, documentation needs, training actions, and process metrics.

use_cases.title: Audit Readiness Review
use_cases.description: Prepare internal audit scopes, evidence checklists, management review inputs, and certification follow-up actions.

use_cases.title: CAPA and Process Improvement
use_cases.description: Organize nonconformity handling, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and effectiveness verification across QMS processes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a QMS Gap Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ISO 13485 QMS gap analysis plan for a small medical device company. Include evidence to collect and priority levels.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Document Control Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a document control workflow for SOPs, work instructions, and forms. Include approval steps, version control, distribution, retention, and change control.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Management Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a management review agenda and input checklist for ISO 13485 clause 5.6. Include metrics, decisions, and action tracking.

prompt_templates.title: Build Audit and CAPA Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a risk-based internal audit plan for the next year. Include process priorities, auditor needs, CAPA follow-up, and effectiveness checks.

output_examples.input: Need to prepare a document control procedure for ISO 13485.
output_examples.output: A structured procedure outline covering document creation, review, approval, release, distribution, change control, retention, and obsolete document handling.

output_examples.input: Need a management review for the next quarter.
output_examples.output: An agenda, input checklist, decision log outline, action tracker, and follow-up verification plan for leadership review.

output_examples.input: Need an internal audit schedule for the next year.
output_examples.output: A risk-based audit calendar with process priorities, audit criteria, auditor assignments, reporting expectations, and CAPA follow-up checkpoints.

best_practices: Provide product type, markets, QMS scope, and current procedures before asking for detailed outputs.
Ask for traceability to ISO 13485 clauses when drafting procedures or audit criteria.
Have qualified quality and regulatory reviewers approve outputs before implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated procedures as approved QMS documents without formal review.
Do not request certification claims without objective audit evidence.
Do not use generic templates without adapting responsibilities, records, and regulatory scope.

faq.question: Can this skill certify an ISO 13485 QMS?
faq.answer: No. It supports preparation and documentation, but certification must come from an accredited certification body.

faq.question: Can it draft QMS procedures?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft procedure outlines and workflows for document control, audits, management review, CAPA, and related QMS processes.

faq.question: Does this package include working automation scripts?
faq.answer: No. The package contains placeholder example files, so automation must be added separately.

faq.question: Which standards and regulations does it reference?
faq.answer: It references ISO 13485, ISO 14971, FDA 21 CFR 820, and EU MDR Article 10 alignment topics.

faq.question: Can it help with internal audits?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help plan audit scope, criteria, schedules, checklists, reports, findings, and CAPA follow-up.

faq.question: What information should users provide?
faq.answer: Provide product type, target markets, QMS scope, process owners, current documents, CAPA history, and audit status.
